data.one_liner: Google Analytics wrapper for all Flutter platforms including Windows and Linux
data.what_it_does: Ambilytics provides a unified analytics interface across Android, iOS, macOS, Web, Windows, and Linux. It uses Firebase Analytics for supported platforms and the GA4 Measurement Protocol for Windows and Linux.
use_when: You need Google Analytics across all six Flutter platforms, including desktop.
You want a unified event tracking and navigation observation interface.
avoid_when: You require full automatic geo, demographic, and language data collection on Windows and Linux.
You only need mobile or web analytics and can use standard Firebase plugins directly.
strengths: Brings Google Analytics support to Windows and Linux via Measurement Protocol.
Provides a unified API wrapping different backends.
Includes navigation observers and automatic app start tracking.
weaknesses: Measurement Protocol on Windows and Linux does not support standard events like screen_view out-of-the-box.
Requires manual configuration of both Firebase and GA4 Measurement Protocol API secrets.
data.setup_notes: Requires running flutterfire configure, editing macOS entitlements, and setting up a GA4 Web stream and API secret.
